include.spryker/locale: Provides the current storefront locale used to scope Storefront Assistant catalog lookups.
include.spryker/customer: Provides the storefront session customer identity for the Storefront Assistant.
include.spryker/storage: Provides the key-value storage used by the Storefront Assistant.
include.spryker/store: Provides the current storefront store used to scope Storefront Assistant catalog lookups.
include.spryker-shop/shop-ui: Provides ShopUi molecules used in Twig templates (ajax-provider, ajax-loader, main-popup).
include.spryker/transfer: Provides transfer objects definition with strict types and `::get*OrFail()` functionality.
